title: Coincident apical and basal input makes the neuron fire a burst

statements.text: When the basal and apical compartments are depolarized at about the same time, the chance of a burst of action potentials rises sharply. An apical calcium spike can turn a single somatic spike into a burst of two to four spikes within about 20 ms.

sources.quote: If basal and apical compartments are depolarized at around the same time, the probability that the neuron fires a burst of action potentials is greatly increased
converting a single somatic action potential into a brief burst of two to four action potentials within about 20 msec
